genre.zh: 法式內衣時裝型錄（Eres、Ysé 那種）
genre.en: a French lingerie fashion catalogue in the manner of Eres and Ysé: soft editorial light, elegant and discreet, fabric and lace in focus

s: the bra hangs from a brass hook on a warm blush-pink wall, hard afternoon sun through leaves casting dappled shadows over the lace and the wall
shot from directly overhead: the bra laid flat on two-tone paper, terracotta and cream, one hard light from the side making the lace cast tiny shadows
the bra draped over the back of a velvet chair in a sage-green room, sun through blinds striping the lace and the wall

the bra hangs by its straps from a wooden peg on a laundry drying rack, filling the frame, against a terracotta-orange balcony wall, hard morning sun from the left casting the cup shadows sharply across the plaster

the bra lies open on a rumpled unmade bed with deep-sea-blue linen, shot from above and large in frame, a strip of hard window light from the right laying a crisp diagonal shadow across the cups and band
the bra rests on a mint-green bathroom tile shelf beside a folded towel, huge in the foreground, low hard sun through the window from behind throwing the shadow of its curves long across the tiles
the bra is pinned to a clothesline by its band against a tomato-red painted wall, hard noon sun from above-right printing a sharp scalloped shadow of the cups on the wall behind it
the bra sits on top of a stack of freshly folded clothes in an open wardrobe lined in sage green, one shaft of hard side light from the left casting a crisp shadow down the stack

the bra lies on a dressing-room bench in a fitting booth with a dusty-rose-terracotta curtain, the side cups tilted upward to show the lift, hard light from the right through a curtain gap casting a sharp shadow diagonal
the bra hangs on a hook on the back of a bedroom door painted deep teal, large in frame, hard late-afternoon sun from the left raking across it and casting a crisp cup shadow on the door

the bra is laid on a wooden chair seat beside a pair of matching briefs, shot from above on a mustard-yellow painted floor, a bar of hard window light from the top-left drawing a sharp shadow of the straps across the floor

the bra with its removable pad pulled half out of the pocket lies on a vanity stool in a mint-green bedroom, hard side light from the right highlighting the pad edge and throwing its shadow onto the seat
the bra rests on an open dresser drawer lined in coral-orange paper, filling the frame, hard overhead sun from a skylight casting sharp shadows between the folds
the bra hangs from a bathroom towel rail against a cobalt-blue tile wall, large in frame, hard sun from a frosted window on the left throwing the wide strap shadow sharply across the tiles

the bra lies on a bedroom floor of warm clay-orange tiles beside a pair of slippers, shot from above and filling the frame, a hard shaft of morning window light from the right casting the deep-cup shadow long across the floor
the bra is draped over the back of a wooden chair against a deep-green wall in a bedroom, hard low sun from the left carving a crisp shadow of the wide straps on the wall

the bra sits on the lid of a laundry basket painted tomato red, close and large, with the wide strap and hook-and-eye band spread wide, hard side light from the right throwing a sharp shadow down the basket
the bra lies on a sunlit mint-green bed sheet next to a folded cardigan, overhead hard light from the window casting a clean shadow that shows the smooth seamless cup surface

the bra lies flat on a dark-teal velvet armchair, lace filling the frame, a thin blade of hard window light from the left striking across it and casting the lace pattern as a sharp shadow onto the velvet
the bra hangs from the corner of a vanity mirror in a bedroom with a deep-wine-red wall, large in frame, hard side light from the right throwing a crisp lace-patterned shadow onto the wall
the bra rests on a terracotta-orange tiled bathroom ledge, shot close with lace large in frame, low hard sun from a window behind casting its scalloped shadow long across the tiles
the bra is laid on rumpled navy-blue bedsheets at the edge of a bed, shot from above, one hard beam of afternoon light from the top-left making a sharp lace shadow on the sheet
the bra hangs over the open door of a wooden wardrobe painted tomato red, large in the foreground, hard sunlight from the left casting its lace shadow across the inside of the door
